en: Good morning, Kiyo.

Good morning...
Are you going to have breakfast as well?
Yeah, are you coming?
Indeed.

I also intend to do some research 
and organize my lab today...

If you are able, can I request 
your assistance?

Organizing your lab? With all the stuff in that
bookcase, it must be hard...

Oh, not at all...
That bookcase is a mountain of treasures.

I've found things besides the Caged Dog 
Village documents that detail other seances.

But the one I am most interested in is, 
of course, still <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
<CLT=cltMIND>The seance again...

In any case, I would like to sort my various 
documents... Well? Will you assist me?
Y-Yeah, sure, if I have time.

Excellent. Please drop by at your earliest 
convenience. Well then...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo's been talking about seances
nonstop lately.
<CLT=cltMIND>He's obsessed with it...
Ah, good morning, Maki.
...Hey, you okay?
Okay? What do you mean?
...If you don't know, then don't worry about it.

W-Well if you say it like that,
it makes me worried!

I got stopped by the student council while
I was going back to my room last night.

They told me...I can't walk around during
nighttime anymore.

What? Why?
It's not breaking the rules, is it?

They said it's because Kirumi committed
her crime during nighttime.

And then Angie gave her usual
"Atua says" speech.
Atua...

We shouldn't ignore Angie. Losing our freedom
may seem fine for now, but soon enough...

...Well, I'm sure Angie's not interested in
anything I have to say.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's true...
We should do something about this.

<CLT=cltMIND>With the student council running things
like this, a rift might form in the group.

<CLT=cltMIND>And then we'll be in a situation
we can't go back from.

<CLT=cltMIND>And resurrecting the dead is
going to be a problem as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
<CLT=cltMIND>Pool Entrance Zelda gimmick plant
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Closed)
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Open)
